results.note: VehicleService part done. zonePass runs a non-baseline-moving watchdog check (_zoneGate) before acting on any zone. A teleport or blatant speed is rewound via violate(); any verdict, a tainted car or a revoked window blocks zones; and a travel-time gate applies (now - driveStartAt >= minTravelTime). violate() taints the car. Also added isTainted, minTravelTime, data.driveStartAt/Pos, and the watchdog now runs before zone in Heartbeat. TheftService.complete and GarageService onDelivery/onChop gates are A2's.

VehicleService part done. PlayerRemoving cleanup is deferred (task.defer) and destroys every Owned car with ownerUserId == leaver ('owner_left'); covered by the spec. Removing the storeCar fallback in GarageService.onDelivery is A2a's.

Replaced AlignPosition with a LinearVelocity. Its target is heading*speed plus a dead-banded, capped pull toward the carrot (Y included), quantized to 0.5 studs/s, and the carrot advances at the same quantized speed. It is written only on change, at most 10 Hz unless the change is urgent. AlignOrientation is written only when heading changes >1°, at most 20 Hz. A car cruising a straight lane writes nothing. Pure _moverVelocity/_quantize are tested.
No server change needed. StreetSpawnService already tags the newbie car with TutorialForUserId and clears it on steal. C1's TutorialController now reads it (verified with grep).

Same change as SEC-1: the zone-time watchdog check, the watchdog-before-zone order and the minTravelTime gate cover DeliveryAttempt, ChopAttempt and SprayAttempt. Not added: the optional 'previous accepted sample must also be inside the zone' rule, because the travel-time gate covers it.

VehicleService part done. addStealPrompt.Triggered now rejects stale holds older than max(required, base)*1.25 + HOLD_MAX_EXTRA (1.5s) (_holdMaxAge, _holdOk maxAge). Interrupted holds were already cleared. This covers every addStealPrompt user (street, carjack, loot, hot-drop claim). The GarageService/DealershipService handlers are A2's.

managePass recycles far cars: it picks a new lane, teleports the car with VehicleService.teleport, resets path, speed, timers and health, and forces a mover write (up to 6 per tick). It destroys and rebuilds only when the count shrinks, at REROLL_CHANCE 0.2, or while EventService.getLuck() > 1, so luck events still re-roll. Spawn/recycle rings are centred 250 studs ahead of players moving >40 studs/s and never placed beyond DESPAWN_DIST-50.

VehicleService part done. wreck() now fires Wrecked before eject (and skips the eject if a handler already destroyed the car). The leaver cleanup is deferred so TheftService's PlayerRemoving handler ends the theft before the driver is cleared. The markDropped/RecoverPrompt guards are A2's; the WantedService order is B1's.
Client-only fix in GarageClient.setupPlot (A2b). VehicleService writes nothing that needs to change.

The fix is in PlotService.pushOut (A2b). VehicleService already exposes what it needs: eject, fromModel, and teleport, which pivots, resets the watchdog, and now also re-bases the drive start of a driven car.
onCarjack heat is now TrafficService._carjackStars(rarity) = max(Police.Heat.carjack, tier.wantedOnSteal), per DECISIONS §1. Tested.

StreetSpawnService.onStolen uses the DECISIONS §1 witness roll: VehicleService._streetStars(wantedOnSteal, wantedChance, rng) = max(1, wantedOnSteal) with probability wantedChance. The free first steal still applies via addStealHeat. I also applied the same rule to Loot re-hotwires in VehicleService, for consistency.

Added a server settling VehicleController (isServer, lazily required) for driverless physics cars. It starts on setDriver(nil), seat-failure and auth-expiry, and on public VehicleService.settle(car), which TrafficService.release calls for rammed/knocked cars. It is stepped on PreSimulation with an auto-brake input, and stopped on seat/setDriver(player) before ownership changes, on wreck, destroy, anchoring, or after SETTLE_MAX=15s. lifePass levels a tipped or hovering car onto flat ground at RideHeight (restPose) before anchoring.

Done: WATCHDOG_MAX_DT 3→1, an upward-displacement teleport check (_watchdogVerdict rise), a fly check (no ground or water within RideHeight+14 for 3s, raycast that ignores cars and the driver), and the SEC-6 fling check. Not done: the optional nitro-budget split of the speed cap, which needs server-side nitro tracking and is a design call.
onOccupantChanged nudges the driver's character out with nudgeOut (raycast-safe) before setDriver(nil). It skips this when the driver is dead or already in another seat.

LOST_Y is now WATER_LEVEL-6 with a 1.5s debounce (LOST_AFTER). Police use VOID_Y (WATER_LEVEL-28) only, because PoliceService rubber-bands its own units. Owned cars are ejected and sent home, other kinds are destroyed, and Stolen is still left to TheftService.

watchdogPass gives a 'fling' verdict when angular speed > 40 rad/s or |vy| > 250 studs/s on two consecutive samples (_flingSample). violate() then rewinds the car, zeroes its velocities, revokes ownership and taints it.
DECISIONS §10 keeps StreamingEnabled off for v1. The source-level PERF fixes (PERF-02, 04, 09, 14) are done instead.

Added VehicleService.allInto(buffer), a non-allocating version of all(), used by scanPass, managePass and lifePass. scanPass rejects by squared flat distance before the cone test, computes each car's right vector once (new optional _aheadDistance param) and fetches player roots lazily once per scan.
Managed EnterPrompt/Hotwire prompts are no longer added to the car trove (createEnterPrompt, addStealPrompt opts.managed). destroy() now destroys st.enterPrompt and st.hotwirePrompt explicitly.
The fix is in PlotService (A2b): use VehicleService.fromModel and VehicleService.teleport. teleport already pivots and resets the watchdog, damage grace and fling/air state.

_crashDamage(prev, vel, elapsed?) scales the threshold by max(1, elapsed/DAMAGE_WINDOW). DAMAGE_WINDOW is 0.2s, so normal tick jitter is unchanged and hitch-time braking or nitro launches no longer cause damage. damagePass tracks st.lastVelAt.

crossGroupNotes: Interfaces delivered per DECISIONS: seat(car, player) -> (ok, reason?) still never throws; teleport(car, cframe) also re-bases data.driveStartAt/driveStartPos when the car has a driver; resetWatchdog(car); minTravelTime(car, targetPos) = flat distance from data.driveStartPos / (topSpeed * SPEED_CAP_MULT * NITRO_SPEED_MULT * max(1, SpeedMultiplier)), 0 if never driven, math.huge for NaN; isTainted(car) is true after any watchdog violation, including ones raised by the zone-time check; Wrecked fires before the eject. results.note: Server controllers (police and settling cars) no longer create Suspension/Drive VectorForces. The same forces are buffered and applied as impulses (force * frame dt) after every velocity read in step(). _zeroForces and destroy() handle the missing movers, and _suppressForeignMovers is skipped on the server. Only the Upright AlignOrientation is still created, and it is written only when its value changes. vehicle.spec now checks that server controllers create no VectorForces, checks the impulse values (recorder chassis), and builds the foreign controllers as client ones.

WheelAnimator: phones (touch with no keyboard and no mouse) use LOW_TIER (RANGE 160, HOT 10, COLD 4, BOB_RANGE 60). Cars more than 12 studs behind the camera are skipped every frame and do not count against the hot budget. Only Vehicles and rainbow cars take a slot. Bob rays are cast every 2nd update, or every 8th for Kind=Traffic, and the last target is reused in between. Weld.C0 is not rewritten when spin, steer and offset are unchanged (within 1e-4).

My only part is the CarBuilder label() SurfaceGuis. There are a handful of small faces on taxi, ambulance, van and police cars, already MaxDistance 160, and 40 px/stud keeps their text readable up close. The GUI-memory cost the audit confirmed is PlotService (A2b) and the EffectsController pulse tags (B1).

My part is done: WheelAnimator.rebuildNear (every 0.25 s) enables a Diamond/Galaxy car's CarBuilder.SPARKLES_NAME emitter only within SPARKLE_RANGE = 120 studs. It finds the emitter again when repaint/applyMutation rebuilds it, and CarBuilder.SPARKLES_NAME is now exported. The street lights (MapBuilder, B1) and the DealershipClient lights and sparkles (A2b) are other groups'.

Removed KeyCode.E from HC_Exit. F, ButtonA and the EXIT button still exit, and the header and comments are updated. I did not hide steal prompts while driving: DealershipClient, EffectsController and CombatClient already own prompt and ProximityPromptService Enabled toggles, and with E unbound a press only starts a hold that the server rejects.

CarBuilder.repaint(model, color) already stores BaseColor and re-applies the mutation (covered by carbuilder.spec 'repaint keeps mutation'), and it is server-safe (pure instance work). B1's WantedService._repaint now calls it.

VehicleController finds the model's BumpStop BaseParts. On new() and on every 0.2 s attribute poll it sets them CanCollide=false; the poll catches a replicated server change turning them back on. destroy() sets CanCollide=true again (pcall), but only on the stops this controller turned off. Tests cover: off while a controller runs, re-disabled on poll, restored on destroy, and stops that were already off left alone. Every real CarBuilder car asserts stop bottom + RIDE_LIFT < Map.CURB_HEIGHT, and that its stops go off and on with a controller.

The settle controller is A1a's (VehicleService.settle/settleStep, already in the tree). My side already supports it: an isServer controller with zero input applies impulses, so it sends no replicated VectorForce traffic, and it turns the bump stops off and back on when destroyed at rest-anchor time.
Server-side fix: A1a's VehicleService calls nudgeOut on a voluntary exit. A client-side nudge in VehicleClient.exit would fight that server move, so I left exit() unchanged.

My part: rebuildNear sets rig.settled = false when a car crosses from beyond BOB_RANGE to inside it (pure helper WheelAnimator.enteredBobRange, tested). An anchored car first posed from far away now gets its bob ray when you walk up. The rest-height spawn is A1a's.

Done: WheelAnimator gives other players', police and traffic cars local tire smoke plus a SoundController.playLoop('TireScreech') loop while they drift. Drift is detected from replicated chassis velocity (WheelAnimator.observedDrift, which reuses the new VMath.isDrifting). It runs only for hot cars within 150 studs, and the effects switch off when a car stops drifting or leaves the hot set. Deferred: nitro flame and horn for observers need an unreliable 'VehicleFx' remote (lead: Remotes; A1a: server validation and fireNear; B1: EffectsController rendering).

VMath.suspensionAccel(comp, compVel, K, C, max, staticComp, stiffScale) computes K*sc + K*(comp-sc)*s^2 + C*compVel*s, so the static load is unchanged. I deliberately deviated from the verified fix: s = SPRING_HOLD_DT/frameDt with SPRING_HOLD_DT = 1/15, not MAX_DT. The spectral-radius analysis shows the plain spring is well damped down to 15 FPS (<=0.69 per frame) and only diverges below ~8.6 FPS. Softening from 30 FPS would have changed the ride on every 15-30 FPS phone. frameDt is clamped to 0.5 s. The test shows the plain spring is unstable at 8 FPS, the scaled one settles at 8, 6 and 4 FPS, and the ride is identical at 15 FPS and above.
DECISIONS.md #12: hero-shell consumption belongs to the art pass. I made no CarBuilder hook now.

B1 moved SPIKES to (1,-144,1,-170) with AnchorPoint (1,1), which matches my touch cluster. I left the DrivingUI touch-button geometry and canvas scale (no touchMin) unchanged on purpose, and documented the footprints in VehicleClient.buildUI so both sides move together.

showUI hides the CoreGui Backpack (pcall SetCoreGuiEnabled false), but only if it was enabled. hideUI, which runs on every exit, death and character removal, re-enables it only if VehicleClient hid it. Spikes use a remote with their own button and key, so nothing is lost. HUDController (C1) already re-runs layout on the Driving attribute, plus a 0.5 s delayed pass.
This is entirely in NotificationController (C1): the touch Dismiss button and anchor. Nothing in my files needs to change, and I kept the DrivingUI control positions stable.

Moved the drift banner from -46 to DRIFT_BANNER_Y = -150 relative to the speedometer top. It now spans H-362..H-318, above the theft panel (H-260..H-184) and clear of the desktop tutorial card (top H-296). THEFT_BOTTOM and CARD_BOTTOM are untouched.
The fix belongs in WaypointController (C1). It can measure DrivingUI Root/Speedometer and Root/Touch the same way HUDController.drivingClearance already does.

DrivingUI part: on touch screens the small labels (car name, MPH, NITRO!, +NITRO) and the touch-button captions get TextSize * textBoost. textBoost = clamp(Theme.TouchMinScale / Kit.uiScale(), 1, 1.4), i.e. 1.31 on phones; it is a pure helper, VehicleClient.textBoost, and tested. I did not pass touchMin to Kit.screen: that would separate the touch cluster from CombatHUD's buttons and grow the speedometer footprint that HUD and tutorial layouts depend on. Toasts, feeds, event pills and banners are C1's.
Same change as PERF-07: phone tier, per-frame behind-camera culling, bob rays every other update, unchanged C0 poses not rewritten.

crossGroupNotes: B1 (PoliceService ~2157): the PreSimulation loop passes math.min(dt, VehicleConfig.MAX_DT) to controller:step. Server controllers now apply impulses = force * dt (PERF-01), so on a server frame longer than 33 ms the suspension and drive impulses would be cut short and the cruiser dips. Pass the raw dt: VehicleController already clamps it internally (math dt <= MAX_DT, impulse length <= 0.5 s). VehicleService.settleStep already passes the raw dt.

A1a: tests/spec/vehicleservice.spec.luau:149 ('wheels rest on the ground: expected ~1.9, got 1.6') fails against the in-progress VehicleService F10 change (anchored kinds now rest at RideHeight with no +0.3). The spec expectation needs updating. It is the only failing test in the suite.

New exports: VehicleController.SPRING_HOLD_DT, VehicleController.BUMP_STOP_NAME, VMath.isDrifting / lowFpsScale; CarBuilder.SPARKLES_NAME; WheelAnimator.BOB_RANGE / LOW_TIER / SPARKLE_RANGE / SPARKLES_NAME plus the pure helpers isLowTier, behindCamera, enteredBobRange, observedDrift; VehicleClient.textBoost. results.note: TheftService.complete now fails a theft whose car is tainted (car goes home), and refuses any delivery made faster than _minDeliveryTime(slot to nearest drop-off edge, topSpeed x SPEED_CAP_MULT x NITRO_SPEED_MULT); _tick also ends tainted thefts. GarageService onDelivery (Loot) and onChop refuse tainted or impossibly fast arrivals via VS.isTainted/minTravelTime. VehicleService's zone gate (A1) was already in place.

An Owned car parks only if ps.outCars[slot]==car and the record matches; otherwise it is destroyed as 'orphan'. The storeCar fallback is gone. onReturnedHome and onVehicleDestroyed ignore cars from other sessions, and cleanup() destroys the leaver's out cars. VS.onPlayerRemoving (A1) does the same.

Applied DECISIONS §5. The recovery bonus needs RECOVERY_MIN_SECONDS of theft or the car leaving the victim's garage (leftGarage, tracked in _tick and recover). Recovery and revenge (both the in-theft and the post-robbery kind) pay at most once per (victim,thief) pair per BONUS_PAIR_COOLDOWN, via the bonusPairs ledger, pruned in start(). Not adopted: basing the bonus on the stolen car's income, and moving the steal contract to delivery (DECISIONS doesn't require either).
The binding fix (heat and restock) is DealershipService (A2b, DECISIONS §2). The optional 'hot' unsellable record in GarageService was not adopted by DECISIONS, so nothing changes in my files.
Same as SEC-1: tainted and too-fast gates in TheftService.complete and GarageService delivery/chop, on top of A1's zoneTrusted gate.

TheftService already handles a mid-theft eject: DriverChanged(nil) leads to a (now deferred) markDropped, so the car stays dropped inside and the victim gets Recover. The remaining fix is PlotService.pushOut, owned by A2b: eject the Stolen-car thief and use VS.teleport for intruders' own cars. As of now PlotService has no eject call yet.

Display StealPrompt: PromptButtonHoldEnded now clears an interrupted hold, and Triggered uses GarageService._holdOk (min required, max age base*1.25+1.5). The leaver's holds are cleared on PlayerRemoving. TheftService's fallback takeover prompt got the same HoldEnded and max-age checks. DealershipService is A2b's.
Same as F2-recovery-revenge-farm: min duration / left-garage gate on recovery, plus the per-pair 600s cap on recovery and revenge.

TheftService now listens to VS.Wrecked (failTheft 'wrecked' with skipDestroy). markDropped, recover and the RecoverPrompt ignore wrecked or destroyed cars, and _tick ends wrecked thefts. markDropped on DriverChanged(nil) is deferred and re-checked, so a bust's fail and a thief leaving win. Client-only fix in GarageClient.setupPlot (A2b). No server change is needed.

beginTheft rolls back on a refused seat. takeover seats before any bookkeeping, restores data.theft.thief on failure and keeps the drop prompts. onStolen returns takeover's result, so VS skips its Stolen signal.

The fix is in RewardsService/MonetizationService (B2): defer car grants while TheftService.getActiveTheft(player) is set and freeSlots<=1. My side: the full message in complete() now carries the unlock hint.
Same as DATA-1: sequential victim-then-thief saves in one task. Spec asserts the order.
Same as theft-eject-before-fail: Wrecked listener, wreck guards, deferred drop. Spec covers wreck, the tick fallback and bust ordering.
NotificationController (C1). Cars already carry TheftActive, TheftVictimUserId and TheftThiefUserId attributes.
onThiefHit returns early only when attacker==theft.victim; otherwise it falls through to the recentRobbers check (still subject to the pair cap). Spec case added.

On a garage-full Loot delivery, GarageService fires Waypoint('chop', chop zone position, orange, 'CHOP SHOP') and clears it on the next successful delivery or chop. The Cash Rain waypoint is EventsClient (C1).
EventService claim warning (B2). GarageService.fullHint(player) is available for that message.

onChop now tells Owned cars '🔧 That's your own ride! Sell it from your garage instead.' and Stolen cars 'Deliver it to your garage instead!', rate-limited to every 4s. A1 added the chop dwell in VehicleService.
_padInfo.passOnly keeps its meaning. GarageClient (A2b) must show 🔒 MAX SLOTS instead of '+2 SLOTS PASS' when Monetization.Passes.slots.id == 0 (DECISIONS §11).

SellPrompt hold is 1s up to Rare and 2.5s for Epic+. Legendary+ sells are two-step: the first trigger arms ps.sellArm and shows a confirm toast, and a second sell within 8s completes it. This covers the prompt and the SellCar remote.

New public GarageService.fullHint(player) (pure _fullHint) returns ' Or unlock slot N for $X at the glowing pad!' (empty once all cash slots are bought). It is appended to the GarageService delivery-full message and to TheftService's full messages (_canSteal 'full', canTakeover, complete). DealershipService already calls it.
The income tick auto-collects every 2s while the owner's root (on foot or seated) is over the CollectPad (_overPad) and uncollected >= $1. The Touched path is unchanged.

crossGroupNotes: Interfaces I coded against (A1, present in the working tree): VehicleService.seat -> (ok, reason) never throws; VS.isTainted(car); VS.minTravelTime(car, pos) from car.data.driveStartAt/driveStartPos; VS.getFolder(); VS.Wrecked fired before eject. TheftService also falls back to car.data.tainted if isTainted is missing. Its own slot-to-drop-off gate (_minDeliveryTime) mirrors VS._minTravelTime (SPEED_CAP_MULT x NITRO_SPEED_MULT x max(1, SpeedMultiplier)).
New public API: GarageService.fullHint(player) -> string. A2b's DealershipService already uses it.

New replicated attribute for A2b's GarageClient (F7): plot model attribute 'RobbableAt' = server time the victim's robbery cooldown ends (0 = none). Disable or relabel the Steal prompt while Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < RobbableAt, while any pad has State=='BeingStolen', or while the local snapshot shows 0 free slots.

A2b PlotService (driving-physics F3 / DECISIONS §9): pushOut must call VehicleService.eject on a thief in a car Stolen from this plot's owner, then push only the character, and must move intruders' own cars with VehicleService.teleport. TheftService's deferred DriverChanged -> markDropped then leaves the car dropped inside with the victim's Recover prompt. PlotService has no eject call yet.

A2b GarageClient: GC-STEAL-PROMPT-INIT-ORDER (call updatePlotPrompts(view) in setupPlot) and economy F2 (pads 11-12 show MAX SLOTS when the slots pass id is 0). Optionally, refreshUncollected can return early for non-owners (PERF-08).

Behaviour change: an Owned car delivered to the drop-off parks only if it is the car this session took out of that slot (ps.outCars). Otherwise it is destroyed with reason 'orphan' and never stored. GarageService.cleanup now also destroys the leaver's out cars ('owner_left').

Behaviour change: GarageService no longer pushes a snapshot every 3 income ticks, only when income or multiplier changes, plus the existing discrete markDirty calls. No client reads snapshot uncollected (checked with grep).
Waypoint id 'chop' is fired and cleared by GarageService. WaypointController (C1) already styles 'chop' keys.
B2 (F10): defer reward/exclusive car grants while TheftService.getActiveTheft(player) ~= nil and GarageService.freeSlots(player) <= 1.
B1: CombatService (onThiefHit before eject) and WantedService (fail before eject) were already done. TheftService now tolerates the old order too.

Test seams added: GarageService._trackOutCar/_cleanup/_onVehicleDestroyed, TheftService._onWrecked, and hooks.defer (theft.spec sets it to run immediately). The theft.spec VehicleService.seat mock now returns true or (false, 'sit failed').

results.note: DealershipService: new pure _stealHeat(carId) = min(5, max(Heat.dealerSteal, tier.wantedOnSteal+1)) per DECISIONS #2, used both for addHeat and the StealPrompt ObjectText. A robbed pad now stays empty until the global restock (_padRestockAt gets a 'stolen' arg); a sold pad still refills after 30s. Blocking the sale of a 'hot' record is an optional GarageService follow-up for A2a.

PlotService.pushOut: when a non-owner is driving a car stolen from this garage (Kind=='Stolen' and TheftVictimUserId == owner; pure helper _ejectOnLock), it calls VehicleService.eject and pushes the thief out on foot. The car stays inside so TheftService can mark it dropped and offer Recover (DECISIONS #9).
Same pushOut fix as driving-physics F3. Every other driven car is moved with VehicleService.teleport. GarageClient needed no change for this.
Duplicate of chase-events-dealer F1: dealer heat now scales with rarity (Legendary 3★, Mythic/Secret 4★), and robbed pads wait for the global restock.

DealershipService part done. Steal and buy prompts now have PromptButtonHoldEnded handlers that drop an early release, and pure _holdOk rejects too-short holds and stale ones (older than max(required,base)*1.25+1.5s). PlayerRemoving and clearPad still clear holds. GarageService (A2a) and VehicleService (A1a) parts belong to their owners.
GarageClient.setupPlot now calls updatePlotPrompts(view) after renderPads, so display cars set up before their plot view existed get their Steal prompt re-evaluated. No server change needed.

PlotService.onCharacter calls WantedService.consumeRespawnAtHQ (lazy, pcall). When it returns true, the character is pivoted to MapLayout.bustedReleaseCFrame()+jitter instead of home. The WantedService side was already done by B1.

Nothing to change in DealershipClient. Its Vehicles.DescendantAdded handler is a single IsA check per descendant, which is negligible. The real cost is TrafficService destroy/respawn churn, which is A1a's recycling fix.

DealershipService part done. onSteal now reads seat's real result. On failure it destroys the Loot car, puts the display car back on the pad, skips heat and contract credit, and notifies the player. A failed spawn now also restores the pad. TheftService is A2a's part.
DealershipService part done (same change as BUG-1). TheftService and GarageService belong to A2a; EventService was already done by B2.
Dealer steal part done: no heat or progress unless the thief is actually seated, and the heist is rolled back otherwise. The TrafficService carjack part belongs to A1a; EventService was done by B2.

pushOut resolves the car with VehicleService.fromModel, zeroes chassis velocity, then calls VehicleService.teleport (which pivots and resets the watchdog). It falls back to a raw PivotTo only for models VehicleService doesn't know.
Covered by the pushOut change: stolen cars are no longer moved (eject instead), and every other driven car goes through VehicleService.teleport.

Re-arm is now max(LOCK_REARM, 0.5 * last button-lock duration) per DECISIONS #8 (pure _rearmSeconds). Only tryLock records the duration, so a Lockdown purchase doesn't lengthen the re-arm. LockReadyAt shows the real value.

lockFor now stacks: min(max(lockedUntil, now) + seconds, now + 3600) (pure _stackLock, DECISIONS #7). lockFor also returns true/false, so MonetizationService's `res == false` check can refuse to charge when there is no plot, and its pushOut call is pcall-guarded.

PlotService: surfaceGui takes a maxDistance. Pad decals drop to 12 px/stud (from 24) and bay signs to 20 (from 30), with UI strokes scaled to match. Pad, sign, dropoff, collect and lock GUIs use MaxDistance 160 (the dropoff hanging sign 250); banners, murals, the gate countdown and the owner sign keep 400. B1 already did the EffectsController part, and GarageTag billboards were already MaxDistance 80.

DealershipClient: the Epic+ glow PointLight and Legendary+ sparkles turn off beyond FX_RANGE=160 from the camera, toggled only when the state changes. B1 already did the MapBuilder lamps. Distance-gating the CarBuilder mutation sparkles on street and garage cars belongs to A1b (WheelAnimator).

GarageClient part done: refreshUncollected returns early for cars the viewer doesn't own (hides the label, no Format/text work). Removing the per-tick Uncollected writes and the 3-tick snapshot belongs to GarageService (A2a).
Per DECISIONS #10, streaming stays off for v1, and the verified fix says to measure before changing anything. The concrete GUI-memory reduction is done under PERF-12.

Each plot now gets an invisible, non-colliding, Neutral 'PlotSpawn' SpawnLocation at OwnerSpawn (Duration 0). It is enabled while the plot is owned, assign sets player.RespawnLocation to it, and release clears it. onCharacter still pivots home as a fallback, skipping the pivot when the character is already within 8 studs of the spawn. Still needs a Studio check that RespawnLocation is honoured.

GarageClient turns Steal off when the server would refuse anyway: a pad in that plot is in State BeingStolen, the plot's RobbableAt (A2a's TheftService attribute) is in the future, or the viewer has no free slots (pure _freeSlots on the StateController snapshot). The reason shows on the car's billboard ('🚨 BEING ROBBED' / '🛡️ PROTECTED m:ss' / '📦 YOUR GARAGE IS FULL'), it re-renders every second, and it re-enables once RobbableAt passes.
DealershipService's full-garage messages (buy and steal) now append GarageService.fullHint(player), using A2a's helper through call(); it falls back to '' if the helper is unavailable.
GarageClient pass pads read '🔒 MAX SLOTS' (TextDim) while Passes.slots.id == 0, and '+2 SLOTS PASS' only when the pass is on sale (pure _lockedPadLabel, DECISIONS #11).
Same renderPad change as economy F2.

The LOCK pill's bottom is now max(112, HUDController.getBottomClearance()+8), so outside the garage it sits above HOME (both screens use Kit.uiScale). Taps while locked or recharging get a pop and a Click sound.
GarageClient part done: GarageHUD.Enabled follows HUDController.isHidden()/VisibilityChanged. NotificationController, WaypointController and TutorialController belong to C1.

Restock sign is lowered to SIGN_BOTTOM=8.5 with SIGN_SIZE height 8, so the frame tops out at floor+17.0 (about CURB_TOP+17.2). That clears the canopy underside (+18) and the LightPanel (+17.7), and the board stays above the cars. B1 already removed MapBuilder's RestockBoard.
Duplicate of the dealer-board finding. B1 deleted the MapBuilder board; DealershipService keeps its own sign, now lowered.

Nothing to add in DealershipService. A2a's GarageService delivery-full path already fires the 'chop' waypoint. A dealer-side waypoint would go stale, because only GarageService's own chopWaypoint flag clears it. The dealer toast names the Chop Shop and now adds the unlock hint.
Not an A2b fix: the server-side check goes in VehicleService.canHotwireLoot (A1a). DealershipClient's audience filter is cosmetic by design.
B2 removed every luck claim, and DECISIONS #3 says rebirth doesn't change luck. DealershipService makes no luck claim and uses EventService.getLuck as intended.
The fix is entirely in TutorialController (C1). The verified fix says no PlotService change is needed.
The fix is in TutorialController (C1). DealershipClient's audience filter behaves correctly.

crossGroupNotes: A2a TheftService: after a lock push-out ejects the thief, the stolen car sits dropped inside the locked garage. If the dropped car is within prompt range of the gate, the thief can re-enter it (re-seat/takeover) from outside, and pushOut ejects them again every 0.5s: harmless, but a loop. A2a: GarageClient reads the plot attribute RobbableAt (server time, 0 = none) exactly as TheftService.syncRobbableAt writes it. The client also treats any pad State == 'BeingStolen' as victimBusy, so keep that pad state accurate for the whole theft, including while dropped.

Purchases now stack (DECISIONS #7), but the success toast still says 'sealed for 10 minutes'; B2 may want to reword it.

PlotService creates a SpawnLocation named 'PlotSpawn' in each Plot<i> model and sets player.RespawnLocation in assign. map.spec's 'one SpawnLocation' test covers MapBuilder output only, so it is unaffected.
